QuestInfo.name: [LINE FRIENDS] Honorary Paparazzi
QuestInfo.0: It's time to get those cameras poised and those shutters snapping! First, you've gotta take some photos of #bMaple World's Famous People#k!
QuestInfo.1:
Snap 3 pictures of Maple World's famous people for CONY. It looks like the camera she gave you is an older model, so the flash takes #b5 minutes#k to charge back up after taking a photo.
Her only guideline is to not take more than one picture of the same person on a given day, so use this as a chance to rove around and catch up with Maple World's movers and shakers!
QuestInfo.2: You delivered 3 pictures of #bfamous people#k to CONY and received a LINE FRIENDS Sticker as a gift. It looks like they'll come in handy when you need to take your emoting to the next level.
